20MiB/1000-page and mobile limits exerci.detail: Size gate runs on declared metadata BEFORE any byte read: '20MiB size gate rejects before any byte read; boundary passes to the reader' asserts a 20_971_521-byte candidate is rejected kind=too_large with spy-counted ZERO slice/arrayBuffer calls, and the inclusive 20_971_520 boundary proceeds to the real reader using a tiny generated PDF. 'mobile profile: 10MiB gate and 5-page selection cap' pins ?profile=mobile, rejects 10_485_761 bytes with zero reads, asserts the '10 MiB' copy, and refuses the 6th page of an 8-page document visibly. '1000-page boundary' opens a REAL generated 156_246-byte PDF (asserted <1MiB) to 'Pages 1-48 of 1000' with page 1000 reachable via jump, and rejects a 1001-page document as the distinct kind too_many_pages. No allocation above 1MiB anywhere in the suite.

wrong MIME/header, encrypted and malform.detail: 'wrong MIME, wrong header, encrypted and malformed are distinct errors' offers four real files through the real input: image/png+PNG bytes -> #open-error-not_pdf with detail mime:image/png; application/pdf+plain text -> #open-error-not_pdf with detail header:no-%PDF-magic; a real /Encrypt-dictionary PDF -> #open-error-encrypted (real PasswordException via pdf.js); a truncated real PDF -> #open-error-malformed (real InvalidPDFException). The test asserts >=3 distinct canonical messages, distinct detail reasons, and that each rejection returns the drop zone to an enabled idle state. too_large and too_many_pages are proven distinct kinds in the limits tests — five distinct OpenError.kind buckets exercised total.
tests: tests/browser/open.spec.ts:243 'wrong MIME, wrong header, encrypted and malformed are distinct errors'

new file revokes old generation first.detail: 'new file revokes the old generation before teardown; stale messages rejected' opens doc A, proves a schema-valid MessageFactory-built WorkerMessage stamped with generation A is already rejected {ok:false, code:'stale_generation'} with no run active; offers doc B through the UI and CANCELS the ReplaceConfirmDialog (doc, generation and event log untouched); then confirms: the 'clear' controller event records retired generation A, the 'teardown' event records generation A+1 — proving the generation was bumped BEFORE the old pdf.js handle closed — followed by validated/opened/metadata events for doc B under generation A+1, and doc B's sha256 differs. After replacement, the same generation-A message is rejected stale_generation again. 'clear releases the document' also asserts teardown under the bumped generation and immediate reuse.
tests: tests/browser/open.spec.ts:507 'new file revokes the old generation before teardown; stale messages rejected'
tests/browser/open.spec.ts:927 'clear releases the document and returns the drop zone to idle'

page selection never silently excludes a.detail: '25 pages: select-all caps visibly; the plan enumerates exactly the selection' — default selection is exactly 1 of 25 (page 1, never all); the 'up to 20 pages' cap notice is visible before any run; select-all yields '20 of 25 pages selected' with page 21 visibly unselected; toggling page 21 is REFUSED (count stays 20, aria-pressed stays false, notice persists — not silently trimmed); after two explicit deselects page 21 fits and the count reads '19 of 25'. Clicking 'Compare selected pages' freezes the plan: the DOM plan's data-page set equals EXACTLY {2..20} (index set equality asserted), every selected page carries all three capabilities (native_text, render, ocr), and the coordinator pins selectedPagesTotal=19. The mobile test exercises the 5-page cap the same way (6th page refused visibly).
